files.rationale: Kept PR A's rename to generateNewTrace (used by all callers, noop_hub and hub_adapter) and made it reset traceId, PR A's sampleRand and PR B's sampled flag together, so both per-trace values are cleared when a new trace starts.
Kept both new fields, PR A's sampleRand and PR B's sampled, along with PR B's toSentryTrace that propagates the sampled flag.
